commit.message: v7/v8 final results; kev-4b and kev-8b previews updated on the Hub (v7 recipe); README/cards/figure/PLAN; locked reads recorded
locked_test: explicit redo of a partition whose read crashed before any aggregate existed (recorded in the summary)
locked_test: an interrupted read may finish untouched partitions; never re-reads a partition
anchoring study: not a lever at 4B (MMLU/PAWS unchanged); best 4B calibration at w=0.3
v8 4B plan
decision-v8 = v7 + shipping_delay family (structures reused from v7); mirror pinned
v7 final plan: 8B x2, 4B seed 2
Modal: independent per-trial spawns on the deployed app (no fragile parent); resume entrypoint for interrupted trials
run_study: lock file so a duplicate execution never launches or overwrites trials
shipping_delay: day-precision date-threshold Score family (the deadline skill)
v7 4B results (0.773/0.790; seed 1 clears the screen), untrained 8B/30B-A3B baselines (kev-8b +5.8/+9.7 pp), PLAN
Durable studies via the deployed app; v7 8B, 4B seed 2, and anchoring plans
Modal: studies fan out server-side (run_study spawned; survives local disconnects); pull entrypoint; anchors/probe spawn
Base anchoring: kev.anchors builds frozen-base zero-shot targets per training question; train --anchor/--anchor_w KL(base || model) aligned by option key; allowlisted; Modal entrypoint
Calibration top-bin table + signed confidence bias; --remote System One scorer; base-model probe writes benchmark rows and runs on Modal (big-MoE untrained baseline)
PLAN: v0.2 plan and the failing-pair analysis
autoresearch release-check (all seeds of a config must pass the screen); publish --tag

decision-v7: 60 random rule structures with negation anywhere (held-out/locked structures excluded by canonical key), four ordinal Score threshold families, rendering styles 3/4; dev/test byte-identical to v4; Hub mirror pinned

README refresh: family figure, kev-4b quick start with real output, weights table, frozen-suite and Jev sections rewritten around v4 results, new playground/chess screenshots; serve reports the Hub id; cards use transfer-v4 Jev numbers
